equivalence_rule.normalization: Replace each runtime-specific /0x[hex]+ hidden suffix with /0x<HIDDEN> before family comparison.
equivalence_rule.generated_or_hidden_membership: Use the same generated/hidden classification implemented by the reviewed successor validator; no family may be silently dropped.

non_vm_rule.scope: All generated/hidden families whose source is not __JVM_LookupDefineClass__.
non_vm_rule.requirement: Exact multiplicity equality for every normalized family key across the two fresh offline repeats.

vm_lookup_define_rule.scope: Generated/hidden families whose source is exactly __JVM_LookupDefineClass__.
vm_lookup_define_rule.requirement: The normalized family-key set must be exactly equal across repeats. Per-family multiplicity may differ because JVM-hidden helper instantiation count is nondeterministic.
additional_guards: The exact logical source tree is unchanged.
The exact immutable platform image, Java executable, Python, Bash, Git and sha256sum bytes are unchanged.
The exact accepted dependency-store archive and manifest bytes are unchanged.
The ordered runtime dependency graph is byte-identical across repeats.
Every resolved external runtime artifact is an exact accepted-store byte.
The fixed worker class and 10/10 passing result are identical across repeats.
Both full raw class-load logs and the complete normalized census are preserved for independent audit.

equivalence_rule.ordinary_lazy_class_loads: Differences outside the generated/hidden census are preserved and reported but do not participate in this generated/hidden equivalence decision; their source bytes remain covered by the complete runtime/platform inventories and ordered runtime graph.

fail_closed: Any generated/hidden normalized family present in only one repeat rejects equivalence.
Any multiplicity drift in a non-VM generated/hidden family rejects equivalence.
Any changed logical source, platform/tool byte, accepted store byte, runtime graph, fixed worker identity/result or unresolved dependency rejects equivalence.
Any unclassified generated/hidden family or missing raw class-load evidence rejects equivalence.
explicit_non_authority: No prior failed/incomplete capture is retroactively accepted.
No supplemental capture authority until a fresh successor passes this rule.
No expected manifest, prepared worker, R1 permit, claim, seed, allocation or gameplay authority.
next_gate: Independently review this exact equivalence rule. If accepted, implement it without changing source/store/platform/fixed-worker scope and dispatch one fresh supplemental capture successor.
